qualified_programs.description: Generic program-category names only, never lender brand names.

document_checklist.description: Specific documents FCH must collect to underwrite the recommended programs, e.g. '6 months business bank statements (all pages)', 'Government-issued Photo ID', 'Voided business check', 'EIN Confirmation Letter (CP 575 or 147C)', 'Year-to-Date Profit & Loss Statement', 'Previous year business tax returns'. Never return an empty list.

lender_name.description: Must exactly match a name present in active_lender_matrix.

internal_summary.description: Full internal underwriting memo for FCH staff.

admin_status_note.description: A concise note for the application's Status Notes field: at most 700 characters, plain prose, no lender names and no internal thresholds or routing terms. Summarises the outcome and the immediate next action for the reviewer.
